purpose: Defines every input file the EarthMimic pipeline consumes, the exact columns, units, types and valid ranges. Data engineers delivering clean data must match these schemas byte-for-byte (column names are case-sensitive). All data must come from NASA or challenge-partner sources.

general_rules.ids: cell_id / target_id must be unique, stable across deliveries, and never reused for a different place
general_rules.coordinates: lat in [-90, 90]; lon in [-180, 180] for Earth, [0, 360] accepted for Moon/Mars; decimal degrees
general_rules.outliers: do NOT delete or cap outliers - the pipeline flags anything beyond robust z-score 6 itself and keeps the value; your job is only to remove genuinely corrupt rows (sensor error codes, duplicated rows, impossible physics)
general_rules.units: exactly as specified per column; no unit conversion surprises (the pipeline converts K to degC itself, do not pre-convert)

files.role: One row per Earth location (grid cell or named site). The candidate pool that target sites are matched against.

columns.name: cell_id
columns.note: unique key, e.g. 'K00' for known analogs, 'C123' for grid cells

columns.name: region
columns.note: human-readable label, e.g. 'Tropics', 'Antarctic'

columns.name: warm_month_high_c
columns.note: mean daily max of warmest month

columns.name: temp_swing_c
columns.note: mean day-night swing

columns.name: wind_ms
columns.note: mean wind speed at 10 m

columns.name: pressure_kpa
columns.note: surface pressure (altitude-dependent)

columns.name: soil_wetness
columns.note: top-layer soil wetness; empty over ocean (ocean rows are dropped)

columns.name: dust_aod
columns.note: aerosol optical depth at 550 nm

columns.name: slope_deg
columns.note: mean slope from terrain tiles inside the cell

columns.name: relief_m
columns.note: std-dev of elevation inside the cell

columns.name: elevation_m
columns.note: above sea level; never compared across bodies, kept for reference

files.role: One row per Moon/Mars site we want Earth analogs for.

columns.name: target_id
columns.note: unique key, convention '<body>-<name>', e.g. 'mars-jezero'

columns.name: description
columns.note: one sentence

columns.name: surf_temp_mean_K
columns.source: Moon: LRO Diviner PRP v2 (modelled annual avg at 2 cm depth). Mars: lander met archives (PDS Atmospheres).

columns.name: surf_temp_max_K
columns.note: annual maximum

columns.name: shallow_ice_share
columns.note: Moon only (Diviner ice-stability depth <= 1 m); empty for Mars

columns.name: slope_deg
columns.note: Moon: Diviner surface triangles. Mars: MOLA over 3.7 km baseline. Baselines differ - keep as-is.

columns.name: relief_m
columns.note: std-dev of elevation inside site radius

columns.name: surf_pressure_Pa
columns.note: Moon: exactly 0 (physical prior). Mars: measured where a lander exists, else 610*exp(-elev/10800)

columns.name: elevation_m
columns.note: from each body's own reference surface; marked non-comparable in metadata

columns.name: cell_id

files.role: Fetch input: named Earth locations added on top of the regular grid.

files.role: Fetch input: which Moon/Mars sites to sample from Diviner (Moon) and MOLA (Mars).

columns.name: radius_km

files.role: Manual/derived Mars climate values merged into targets.csv at fetch time. THIS IS THE FILE WE ARE CURRENTLY FILLING from NASA PDS lander archives (Viking, Phoenix, InSight, REMS, MEDA).

columns.name: target_id
columns.note: must match mars_sites.csv

columns.name: surf_temp_mean_K
columns.note: annual-mean near-surface air temperature

columns.name: temp_swing_K
columns.note: mean within-sol max minus min

columns.name: surf_pressure_Pa
columns.note: annual mean; overrides the elevation-based estimate when present

columns.name: wind_ms
columns.note: mean near-surface horizontal wind

columns.name: dust_tau
columns.note: visible dust column optical depth

columns.name: source
columns.note: dataset id + sols used + caveats, e.g. 'VL1-M-MET-4-BINNED-P-T-V-CORR-V1.0, 333 sols; temp at 1.6 m'

files.role: Column metadata the matching agent reasons over. One entry per data column (not for id/lat/lon/region).

entry_schema.name: column name, must match the CSV exactly
entry_schema.label: human-readable label
entry_schema.dimension: grouping used for balanced weights: thermal | terrain | physics | water | dust | light
entry_schema.quantity: physical quantity: temperature | temperature_delta | pressure | speed | angle | length | fraction | optical_depth | unitless
entry_schema.unit: degC | K | kPa | Pa | m_per_s | deg | m | fraction | unitless | mm_per_day | degC_delta | K_delta
entry_schema.concept: semantic tag used for pairing, e.g. mean_temperature, wind_speed, slope, relief, surface_pressure, dust_optical_depth
entry_schema.version: source dataset + version string - REQUIRED for provenance
entry_schema.priority: int 1-9, targets only: how much this property matters (9 = critical)
entry_schema.comparable: bool, set false to forbid cross-body comparison (e.g. elevation_m)

sample_entry.name: surf_temp_mean_K
sample_entry.label: Mean surface temperature
sample_entry.version: LRO Diviner PRP v2 (LRO-L-DLRE-5-PRP-V2.0); PDS lander met archives
sample_entry.note: Moon: modelled annual average at 2 cm depth. Mars: lander annual mean.

delivery_checklist: Column names and order match this contract exactly (case-sensitive)
Every data column present in the CSV has a metadata entry with name/label/dimension/quantity/unit/concept/version
No placeholder values - empty cell means missing
Each value's source dataset and version recorded in metadata 'version' (and 'source' column for mars_climate.csv)
Units NOT pre-converted (Kelvin stays Kelvin, Pa stays Pa)
All sources are NASA or challenge-partner archives (PDS, POWER, LRO, MOLA); no third-party climate models
Row counts: every target_id in targets.csv appears in sites/*.csv and vice versa; every known_analogs.cell_id exists in earth_cells.csv
